overview: A hybrid platform that acquires frequency-dependent and near-steady thermoreflectance responses without moving the sample. Joint or cross-validated analysis can reduce parameter correlation for selected stacks, subject to model identifiability.
overviewZh: 在不更换样品位置的情况下同时获取频率响应与近稳态热反射信号。对适合的膜层结构，可通过联合分析或交叉验证降低参数相关性，但仍取决于模型可辨识性。
principle: FASTR combines FDTR frequency-response measurements with SSTR steady-heating measurements on one platform. The two modes probe complementary heat-flow regimes. Their data can constrain a common thermal model, but which parameters can be extracted depends on sample structure, calibration and sensitivity.
principleZh: FASTR 在同一平台结合 FDTR 频率响应测量与 SSTR 稳态加热测量，两种模式探测互补的传热过程。两类数据可共同约束热模型，但可提取的参数仍取决于样品结构、标定与灵敏度。
